item.title: Heating cost surge expected to deepen price crunch
item.description: A report showed heating costs are set to rise at twice the rate of inflation.

item.title: Trump claims Donald Trump Jr. repaid Russian oligarch for wedding party
item.description: No evidence has been provided by the president or the Trump Organization to support the claim.

item.title: Neuroscientist describes growing human brain tissue in mice
item.description: Stanford researchers grew human brain tissue in mice, aiming to advance treatment development.

item.title: Iran live updates: War cost US over $40B, officials tell lawmakers
item.description: U.S. Central Command's new war cost estimates were shared with lawmakers this week, according to sources and documents.
